answers.question: At the final card, "you" appears for the only time in the game (Welcome, you. / You are not on file. / Please wait, you.). What should the player feel at that word?
answers.answer: It should feel degrading, like how they call him a number instead of his name. That “you” is holding a lot of weight and malice. It’s literally belittling his identity by referring to him in the only way which gives him not characteristics. You doesn’t have gender, it’s doesn’t have a name, it’s universal used to give a command to someone beneath you. Example: Hey you, get me something. See how you makes them sound like an object

answers.question: Doc 1 says there is no correct answer and no escape: three ways to stop being a person (§0, §9.1), and on replay the spine shows agency was cosmetic (§1.3, reading 2). Do you still stand by both?
What should this teardown help you decide next?
answers.answer: How to merge, and work back in the old blender and Higgsfield sets. My understanding of game design as increased since I’ve worked with “Who did it” so I’m confident those old pieces can be re used
